role: Base class of every screen: the scaled resolution, the button and label lists, input dispatch (mouse, keyboard, clipboard), the dark background gradients, tooltips and the pause flag.
scope_reason: The container screens, the death screen and the pause behaviour the native client drives all live in this class's contract.

members.name: width
members.note: the scaled sw/sh the screens use

members.name: buttonList
members.note: no button objects; screens draw and hit-test inline; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: drawScreen
members.note: empty base; each native screen draws in raster_hud.c or not at all; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: keyTyped
members.note: the native client's keys go through the recorded input snapshot (play.c); not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: func_146285_a
members.note: renderToolTip: the hovered slot's item name

members.name: func_146279_a
members.note: the one-line hover text: GuiContainerCreative (no creative mode), GuiBeacon (beacon = off) and GuiChat's hovers for an item or achievement that fails to parse, which no vanilla message carries (lane/covclient)

members.name: func_146283_a
members.note: one-line tooltips only; no wrapped list

members.name: mouseClicked
members.note: handled as recorded gui click ops in play.c; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: mouseClickMove
members.note: the drag path is the recorded click mode (screens-drag-s1); not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: handleInput
members.note: the native client polls SDL and writes gui ops in play.c; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: drawDefaultBackground
members.note: the dark gradient over the world; the options-background tiled texture branch is not drawn

members.name: func_146278_c
members.note: the dirt background: drawWorldBackground draws it only with no world (the main menu), and GuiDownloadTerrain.drawScreen (client_cosmetic) never gets a frame: the S08 after the S07 closes it in the same packet pass (lane/covclient)

members.name: doesGuiPauseGame
members.note: the base's true: every screen a run shows overrides it (GuiContainer, GuiChat and GuiSleepMP, GuiGameOver, GuiWinGame, GuiDownloadTerrain, the oracle's JoinScreen); the screens keeping it (GuiIngameMenu, GuiScreenBook, GuiEditSign, GuiCommandBlock, GuiYesNo) are never opened: book_editing and sign_editing are off and Escape only releases the mouse (lane/covclient)

members.name: isCtrlKeyDown
members.note: the native client tracks the key state for the input snapshot

members.name: isShiftKeyDown
members.note: Keyboard.isKeyDown as the last frame polled it (gui_input_frame)

notes: Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): clipboard and raw input dispatch are replaced by gui ops. Formerly listed as missing: The clipboard helpers (getClipboardString, setClipboardString) have no native counterpart. The options-background tiled texture branch of drawDefaultBackground is not drawn (only the dark gradient). A container screen's input is dispatched as handleInput does it (csrc/engine/gui_input.c:gui_input_run: the Mouse queue, then the Keyboard queue, inside the client tick; lane/clientui); the other screens' input goes through the recorded input snapshot and gui ops (play.c). func_146283_a (drawHoveringText) draws every tooltip line with the first line's 2-pixel gap (raster_hud.c screen_tooltip).
